violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity (26 TAC §744.2105(9))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity
violation_type.typical_finding: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that a caregiver has had children sit quietly at a table for 10-20 minutes.

finding_variants.text: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that a caregiver has had children sit quietly at a table for 10-20 minutes.
Based on information obtained it was determined that operation staff utilized prohibited punishment when children were told to do wall sits as a form  of discipline while in care.
During the investigation inspection it was determined that a caregiver withheld a child in cares outdoor play time for discipline.
Children sit inactive at the table in between activities for a prolong amount of time.

Seven children's active play was withheld by the director as a form of discipline and guidance. The children were observed sitting in a classroom while the remaining of their group was outside playing.
